changelog: New desktop sidebar: a slim rail that expands when you hover or focus it, with the Kuronime/Oppa switcher at the bottom and a frosted-glass look while open.
The mobile dock is redesigned as a full-width frosted-glass bar with the active tab highlighted.
Downloads page redesigned: series are grouped in collapsible cards, episodes show their TMDB names and stills, and finished downloads show when they were downloaded.
Posters and covers now fade in smoothly as they load, and the Profile tabs animate when you switch between them.
Remote fix: on remotes that show up as several gamepads at once, one press now moves exactly one step.
The app fonts are bundled with the app, so the first open after installing is fast and everything renders fully offline.
